entries.knownHazards: The hairs on the seed pods can be an irritant to some people and gloves should be worn when harvesting. These hairs can be easily removed by washing[200].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Sėklų ankštis dengiantys plaukeliai kai kuriems žmonėms dirgina odą — renkant rekomenduojama mūvėti pirštines. Plaukeliai lengvai pašalinami nuplaunant.

entries.knownHazards: Do not use during pregnancy or if planning children.
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Nenaudoti nėštumo metu arba planuojant pastoti.

entries.knownHazards: Some reports suggest that the fruit is poisonous[13, 100], whilst it may be very acid it is most definitely not poisonous[65]. Avoid during pregnancy.
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Vaisiai gali būti labai rūgštūs, tačiau nėra nuodingi. Vengti nėštumo metu.

entries.knownHazards: Skin contact with the plant causes dermatitis in sensitive people[222]. Hops dermatitis has long been recognized. Not only hands and face, but legs have suffered purpuric eruptions due to hop picking. Although only 1 in 3,000 workers is estimated to be treated, one in 30 are believed to suffer dermatitis[269]. Dislodged hairs from the plant can irritate the eyes[222]. Sedative effect may worsen depression. Avoid during pregnancy (due to antispasmodic action on uterus). Avoid with breast, uterine and cervical cancers [301].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Augalo sąlytis dirgina odą ir gali sukelti dermatitą jautriems žmonėms; nuplėšti plaukeliai dirgina akis. Sedacinis poveikis gali pagilinti depresiją; vengti nėštumo metu (spazmolitinis poveikis gimdai) ir esant krūties, gimdos ar gimdos kaklelio vėžiui.

entries.knownHazards: Dizziness, chest pain, gastrointestinal distress. Weak potential for sensitization [301].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Gali sukelti galvos svaigimą, krūtinės skausmą ir virškinimo trakto sutrikimus. Nedidelis jautrinimo potencialas.

entries.knownHazards: There is a report that the fresh plant contains the toxin hydrogen cyanide[243]. In small quantities, hydrogen cyanide has been shown to stimulate respiration and improve digestion, it is also claimed to be of benefit in the treatment of cancer. In excess, however, it can cause respiratory failure and even death.
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Šviežias augalas gali turėti vandenilio cianido. Didelės dozės sukelia kvėpavimo nepakankamumą ir gali būti mirtinos.

entries.knownHazards: Plant has spines or sharp edges; use extreme caution when handling
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Augalas turi spyglius ir aštrių kraštų — elgtis atsargiai.

entries.knownHazards: Plant contains calcium oxalate crystals and can cause mild irritation to the throat if eaten[144]. Thorough cooking destroys the toxin. People with a tendency to rheumatism, arthritis, gout, kidney stones and hyperacidity should take especial caution if including this plant in their diet[238].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Augale yra kalcio oksalatų kristalų, kurie valgomus žalius dirgina gerklę; kruopštus terminis apdorojimas toksiną sunaikina. Sergantys reumatu, artritu, podagra, turintys inkstų akmenų ar padidėjusį rūgštingumą turėtų būti atsargūs.

entries.knownHazards: Although no specific reports of toxicity have been seen for this species, the fruits of at least some members of this genus contain saponins and are slightly toxic. They can cause vomiting, diarrhoea and stupor if eaten in quantity[274].

entries.knownHazards: The fruit and probaby other parts of the plant contain saponins and are toxic, causing diarrhoea, vomiting and stupor[10, 274]. However, toxicity levels are low and it is only in very large doses that problems are likely to arise[65, 76]. Do not exceed recommended doses. Fruits particularly poisonous to children [301].

entries.knownHazards: Regular ingestion of large quantities of these plants can be dangerous due to their high mineral content[172]. This report, which seems nonsensical, might refer to calcium oxalate. This mineral is found in I. capensis and so is probably also in other members of the genus. It can be harmful raw but is destroyed by thoroughly cooking or drying the plant[K]. People with a tendency to rheumatism, arthritis, gout, kidney stones and hyperacidity should take especial caution if including this plant in their diet[238].
